title: Correction: protein range [1.6, 2.4] (midpoint 2.0 g/kg outside a cut)
what: athlete_context.json nutrition.protein_g_per_kg [2.0, 2.4] -> [1.6, 2.4]. The code uses the range midpoint outside a cut (now 2.0 g/kg, ~180 g at 90 kg) and the top in a cut (2.4 g/kg).
why: Corrects 2026-11-23-config-change-1, which assumed the low end is used outside a cut; the midpoint was 2.2 g/kg (198 g). Intended per the audit (athlete-approved 2026-11-23): ~2.0 g/kg at recomp/maintenance, 2.4 in a cut; 1.6 is the meta-analytic plateau (PubMed 28698222).
